1. (Currently amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, __wherein the at least one BMC polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide__.

2. (Currently amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Currently amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme.

4. (Currently amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

5. (Currently amended) The cell of [[eihe* claim3er-ctaim-4]] __claim 3 or claim 4__ wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

6. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1any-preceding-claim]] __claim 1__ wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide.

7. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim6wherein]] __claim 6, wherein__ the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

8. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1any pr-eceding-claim]] __claim 1__ wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides.

9. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Currently amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons, __wherein one of the different BMC operons is a eut operon__.

11. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1any-preeeding-claim]] __claim 1__ wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag.

12. (Currently amended) A method __of producing a non-native compartment in a host cell,__ comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide, __wherein the at least one BMC polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae, __and wherein the at least one BMC polypeptide is heterologous to the member of the family Shewanellaceae__.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga.

21. (Currently amended) A method __of producing a product in a cell,__ comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product, __wherein the at least one enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence__.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments.

27. (Previously presented) The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1anye nee f-elaims-1-11]] __any one of claims 1-11__ comprising a plurality of compartments.
